title: Welcome to Gately
subtitle: A few quick steps make your gateway safer and easier to run.

password.title: Change the initial password
password.desc: The initial password was printed in the startup log. Replace it with your own.

security.desc: Enable two-step verification or register a Passkey for stronger sign-in.
